SELECT u.id AS id, IFNULL(u.username, '') AS username, IFNULL(u.nickname, '') AS nickname, IFNULL(u.signature, '') AS signature, u.status AS status, DATE_FORMAT(u.last_login_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lastLoginTime, DATE_FORMAT(u.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime FROM sys_user u WHERE u.id = #{id} AND u.deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET username = #{username}, nickname = #{nickname}, signature = #{signature}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
